class.name: SandWorld
class.brief_description: High-performance cellular automata sandbox simulation engine using sparse chunk grid.
class.description: SandWorld is a GDExtension providing a falling sand simulation engine optimized for Godot 4.x. It uses: - Flat memory layout with 64x64 pixel chunks - Dynamic data-driven material configurations - Sparse chunked world grid for large landscapes - Direct texture rendering via PackedByteArray Features SOLID_POWDER and LIQUID physics, chemical reactions (acid, fire), and interactive brushes.

method.name: add_material
method.description: Register a material type with the simulation. State values: 0=EMPTY, 1=SOLID_FIXED, 2=SOLID_POWDER, 3=LIQUID, 4=GAS. Density determines sinking/floating for SOLID_POWDER/LIQUID (higher sinks); for GAS it inverts, so lower density rises past denser gas/fluid. Dispersion affects liquid/gas horizontal spread. Flammability and acid_reactive use 0-255 probability. decay_chance is the 0-255 per-tick probability this material converts into decay_into (e.g. Fire decaying into Smoke); 0 disables decay.

method.name: brush_circle
method.description: Fill a circular area with particles of the specified material.

method.name: brush_line
method.description: Draw a line of particles with circular brush from point to point using Bresenham's algorithm.

method.name: brush_rectangle
method.description: Fill a rectangular area with particles of the specified material.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clear all particles from the simulation.

method.name: load_snapshot
method.description: Replace the world with a snapshot created by [method save_snapshot]. Returns [code]false[/code] when the data has an invalid or unsupported format; the existing world is left unchanged.

method.name: explosion
method.description: Clear particles in a circular area (destruction effect).

method.name: get_chunk_count
method.description: Return the number of active chunks in the world.

method.name: get_debug_chunk_info
method.description: Return one Dictionary per allocated chunk, for debug visualization. Each entry has: - "chunk_position" (Vector2i): the chunk's coordinates. - "world_rect" (Rect2i): the chunk's 64x64 bounds in world (pixel) coordinates. - "dirty_rect" (Rect2i): world-space bounds of the cells pending simulation next tick. Zero-sized if the chunk is currently asleep.

method.name: get_particle_mat_id
method.description: Get the material ID of the particle at the given position, or 0 if empty.

method.name: render_to_texture
method.description: Render simulation to RGBA8888 PackedByteArray. Can be used with Image.set_data() or ImageTexture.update().

method.name: set_materials_from_dict
method.description: Bulk register materials from a dictionary. Each key is material ID, value is a dict with keys: state, color, density, dispersion, flammability, acid_reactive, decay_chance, decay_into.

method.name: save_snapshot
method.description: Return a versioned binary snapshot of the current sparse world. Snapshot data includes allocated chunks and particle material IDs and flags, but not material definitions.

method.name: set_particle
method.description: Place a particle of the specified material at the given position.

method.name: tick
method.description: Advance simulation by one frame. Call this in _process() or _physics_process() for continuous simulation.

constants.constant: Fixed solid (stone, brick) - does not move.
Liquid (water, oil, acid) - flows downward and sideways.
Gas (smoke, steam, fire) - rises and disperses.
